text:
erin: Quick proposal - introduce an explicit `X-Route-Priority` header for per-request routing priority (values: low/normal/high). Reason: makes server routing decisions and quota mapping deterministic instead of inferring from route hints.

kai: +1 to making routing explicit. Two immediate concerns: (1) SDK ergonomics (how to set it cheaply) (2) telemetry/quotas - we need to avoid cardinality explosion. :eyes:

mike: For SDKs we can add a small `route_priority` optional param to high-level calls. Py/TS can default to `normal` and be non-breaking. Go client will need a new field in Request struct - technically a minor API change but should be source-compatible if we add an optional pointer.

julia: Console UX: we should not add a new required column by default. Suggest dark-launch a "Route priority" column behind a toggle for early customers. Also update alerting so we don't spam on high-priority churn.

kai: Telemetry: record `route_priority` as part of sampling key but limit values to the three buckets. Do NOT attach freeform strings. That keeps metric cardinality sane.

erin: Implementation sketch: server accepts `X-Route-Priority` OR legacy `X-Route` suffix like `-urgent` (for backward compat). Plan: accept both for 90 days, log a deprecation counter. SDKs will emit new header; servers prefer explicit header if present.

mike: Example patches (how SDK callers will look):

Python:
```py
client.generate("...", route_priority="high")
# OR lower-level
client.request("/v1/generate", headers={"X-Route-Priority": "high"})
```

TypeScript:
```ts
await client.generate({ prompt: "...", routePriority: 'high' })
// low-level
fetch('/v1/generate', { headers: { 'X-Route-Priority': 'high' } })
```

Go (sketch):
```go
req := &inference.Request{Prompt: "...", RoutePriority: ptr.String("high")}
client.Generate(ctx, req)
```
Note: RoutePriority is a `*string` to avoid breaking existing literal initializations.

kai: For quotas: map priority to quota buckets: high -> premium bucket (smaller rate), normal -> default, low -> low-priority bucket (sacrifices latency when busy). We'll need a migration plan for existing usage that used route hints.

julia: Console rollout plan: 1) Dark-launch toggle + metadata display 2) Add filter by priority to request logs 3) Add a small econometrics panel in the cost dashboard showing cost/priority distribution.

erin: Backwards-compat plan and dates:
- Week 0: feature flag + server accepts header + SDKs prepared (non-breaking)
- Week 2: Py/TS releases that set header by default opt-in via `route_priority` param (docs + samples)
- Week 6: Console dark-launch for internal and a few beta customers
- Week 12: Emit deprecation counter for legacy hints; send emails to heavy users
- Week 16: Remove legacy implicit mapping server-side

mike: SDK release notes draft: "Added `route_priority` param to high-level calls. Default `normal`. Backwards compatible. Go: new optional `RoutePriority` field - recommended to use pointer helper `ptr.String(...)`."

kai: Telemetry change: sample key will be `model|route_priority|status` for aggregated traces. Add a sampling cap so priority doesn't cause >5x tag expansion. Ops-bot please monitor deprecation counter and a spike in `unknown` values.

ops-bot: Created monitor: `route_priority.deprecation_count > 1000 / day` -> pager oncall-eng.

erin: Action items + owners:
- kai: implement server accept/prefer header + mapping + deprecation counter (ETA 1 week)
- mike: prepare SDK PRs for Py/TS/Go (ETA 2 weeks)
- julia: console dark-launch config + panel mocks (ETA 3 weeks)
- erin: doc + customer comms + rollout plan (ETA 1 week)

mike: One more operational note - for Go we should add a small compatibility test that constructs the old literal `inference.Request{Prompt: "x"}` and ensures it still compiles. If it fails, we revert to alternative (add constructor).

erin: Agreed. If anyone has concrete pushback on the pointer-field approach for Go, speak now; otherwise I'll spin up the RFC PR. :shipit:

kai: No blockers from runtime side. Happy to review the RFC.

mike: I'll open the SDK PRs today with a `beta-route-priority` feature flag in pipelines.

julia: I'll mock the console tiles and send screenshots to #product for beta opt-ins.

erin: Thanks all — I'll create the RFC and track in the rollout board.
